|rulings=* During initiation of this Interrupt, a player chooses a weapon to fire, not a target to fire at. A response to the weapon targeting (e.g. [[Blaster Deflection]]) is played slightly later, after that target is chosen.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Sniper Scomp: Sniper]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). * [[I Have A Bad Feeling About This]] may retarget to a different weapon that can fire, but cannot choose a new target to fire at (because no target to fire at has been selected yet).

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered Revised card, [[Sniper (Revised)]] (September 1998).
